question_record.context: In a security incident involving multiple alerts, a malicious email with a URL (`http://kn017721628.wittytree-b6f239d6.northeurope.azurecontainerapps.io/`) was sent to and removed from the mailbox of `santiago@vnevado.alpineskihouse.co`. Later, the incident revealed an internal phishing campaign and a sequence of suspicious exploration activities, which indicated that an attacker might be coordinating lateral movements. Finally, it was observed that a suspicious service was created to execute potentially malicious commands on MB-ADFS.
question_record.question: Can you identify the email address of the user who created the suspicious service `DDLOXJDSQSNGMUKKFUXQ` on MB-ADFS?
solution: The user account with SID `S-1-5-11-7842151660-4834030208-105586563-1139` received an email containing a malicious URL.
The user account with SID `S-1-5-21-561436748-3867387497-1732241745-3701` was observed sending phishing emails internally, possibly indicating compromise.
A suspicious process `powershell.exe` was detected executing a series of windows commands, likely performing exploration activities.
The process was initiated by a user with AadUserId `ec3ec68b-fdeb-4fe4-9a29-acd445e1ccc5`.
The user `gsmith@niseko.alpineskihouse.co` created a suspicious service `DDLOXJDSQSNGMUKKFUXQ` on `MB-ADFS` to potentially execute malicious commands.
